seoDescription: Landing pages, business websites and monthly maintenance for small businesses in Pretoria. See what we build and ask for a quote.
intro: We build websites for small businesses in Pretoria. Pick a package, or tell us what you need and we will quote it.

items.name: Landing pages
items.text: One clean page that tells customers who you are and gives them an easy way to get in touch.
points: WhatsApp contact button linked to your number

items.name: Business websites
items.text: A multi-page website with your services, photos and a contact form. Higher packages add an editing screen, stronger SEO and a blog.
points: SEO and Google Analytics set up

items.name: Maintenance plans
items.text: We keep your site running after launch and make small changes for you.

items.name: Full-stack web applications
items.text: Custom web apps with logins, databases and dashboards built around how your business works.

items.name: IT admin systems
